claim: Scoville Research v1.0.0 links claims directly to whole source IDs and stores no separate evidence record with a locator or excerpt.
Foundry Defiect and Research Units preserve evidence or source pointers below the whole-source level.
A working and topically relevant citation does not establish that its content factually supports the attached claim.
A Deep-only evidence ledger with source locators and support relations is the highest-value portable addition to Scoville Research.
The current Scoville Deep package has no run manifest schema version phase status Skill hash or external backend job identity.
Defiect Foundry and Research Units persist run identity phase state or drift-auditable lifecycle evidence.
A small versioned run manifest is a portable improvement while a database-backed workflow engine is not required for Scoville Research.
The 24601 adapter records cost limits interaction state polling behavior uploaded-file hashes and cleanup behavior for an external asynchronous backend.
Scoville Research lacks an explicit durable contract for paid asynchronous or uploading research backends even though its Core allows host tools.
Scoville sources record publication and access dates but not accessibility class final URL status or claim-specific freshness scope.
Daymade explicitly records source accessibility and AS_OF freshness but also relies on fixed source quotas and density thresholds.
Scoville should evaluate accessibility and cited-link recheck fields separately without adopting fixed source quotas or confidence derived from source counts.
Firecrawl derives confidence from the number of agreeing sources and activates deep research at three or more sources.
Fixed source counts and agreement counts are not adequate proxies for citation factuality or source independence.
Dimayip and TheRealRay0x require multi-agent orchestration while Scoville keeps delegation optional.
The inspected sources provide no direct benchmark proving that mandatory multi-agent research improves claim support over a capable single coordinator.
GitHub Copilot research prioritizes authorized internal organization implementations for organization-specific questions.
Scoville Development has no explicit internal-first lane for organization-specific research even though its privacy boundary prevents external disclosure.
Foundry classifies mismatched abstract-only degraded and reader-validated source content before synthesis.
An optional source-content quality field would make academic paywall and mismatch failures easier to preserve without changing Scoville source-count policy.
A final liveness recheck for cited URLs is independently testable and can reduce non-resolving citations.
A separate post-hoc citation agent is unnecessary if evidence links are built before synthesis and audited in the final pass.
Provider-specific search stacks cost estimators databases and report renderers should remain adapters rather than dependencies of the portable Scoville Core.
Brainstorm permits an external landscape pass but does not explicitly apply Research rules for untrusted retrieved content private query sanitization inspection depth or source independence.
Brainstorm should adopt Research evidence-integrity rules only inside its landscape and prior-art work.
Brainstorm freezes initial branch prompts before ideation and treats isolation claims as tool-trace-owned while Research does not require those two controls for optional evidence lanes.
Research should freeze first-wave parallel evidence-lane prompts and report independence only from observed isolated calls while keeping later gap queries adaptive.
Research Development can borrow Brainstorm mechanism clustering so several implementations of one approach do not occupy several shortlist positions.
Research and Brainstorm have different primary outputs and should remain independently installable without automatic sibling activation.

An explicit combined workflow can substitute one Research-owned prior-art lane for Brainstorm's native landscape agent while running frozen Brainstorm generators from the same factual frame without pre-convergence exposure.
Research should not adopt originality labels or idea-count targets and Brainstorm should not create Deep research ledgers during ordinary divergence.
Both Skills already preserve a read-only stop and expose a cheapest falsifier or decision-changing next test.
